_fixture_doc.purpose: Regression fixture documenting Success Metric #2 from the task spec: a known CSS-flake case where the a11y normalized path resolves an element that a pure CSS selector previously flaked on.
references: task spec §Success metrics (2): at least one end-to-end run where the a11y path resolves at least one element that a pure CSS selector previously flaked on
Algorithm Decision 1: two-tier a11y probe (exact → normalized regex)

flake_case.description: PrimeNG button with trailing NBSP in accessible name
flake_case.symptom: CSS selector 'button.p-button-save' or get_by_role('button', name='Save') matches 0 elements when the button's aria-label includes a trailing non-breaking space (U+00A0) appended by the PrimeNG renderer
flake_case.css_selector_behavior: FLAKY — times out with 0 matches when DOM churn changes the class list (e.g. after a modal close animation)
flake_case.a11y_exact_tier_behavior: 0 matches — name='Save\u00a0' does not match the DOM's normalized accessible name on all Chromium builds

test_plan_step_example.goal: Click Save button in order form
